items.title: Bitcoin's Inflation-Driven Rally
points: Core PCE inflation (a measure of price changes excluding volatile food and energy costs) rose 3.0% year-over-year in August, below the 3.3% forecast, signaling cooling price pressures.
Cooler inflation reduced market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in October, removing a headwind for Bitcoin and other risk assets.
Bitcoin jumped above $85,000 on the news before settling around $84,400, up 0.4% over 24 hours.

Prediction market traders on Myriad assign 52% odds Bitcoin stays above $84,000 but only 26% probability it surpasses $86,000 within the week; Friday's U.S. jobs report is expected to influence the move.

items.title: CFTC Investigates Adam Kinzinger Over Pardon Bets
points: The CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission, the U.S. regulator overseeing derivatives and prediction markets) opened an investigation into former congressman Adam Kinzinger for trading on Kalshi regarding his potential presidential pardon.
Kinzinger denies wrongdoing, says he made only $823 in profit, and claims he checked platform rules beforehand.

items.title: Senator Blumenthal Links Tether's USDT to Iran Sanctions Evasion
points: Senator Richard Blumenthal's subcommittee concluded that Tether's USDT stablecoin (a cryptocurrency pegged to the U.S. dollar) acts as a 'superhighway' for Iranian sanctions evasion.
The findings were referred to the U.S. Treasury and Department of Justice for potential enforcement action.

items.title: Ex-NCA Officer Must Repay $2.4M for Stolen Bitcoin
points: A former U.K. National Crime Agency officer must repay $2.4 million for 50 Bitcoin he stole from a Silk Road 2.0 seizure in 2017, when it was worth about $77,000.
Prosecutors valued the theft at current Bitcoin prices (~$48,000 per coin), over 30 times the original value, showing how price appreciation compounds criminal liability.

items.title: XRP Price Expectations
points: XRP trades at $1.51, with prediction markets seeing a near coin-flip outcome for its price on October 5 at 4 p.m. UTC.
Traders assign 52% odds XRP finishes above $1.50, 29% probability it lands between $1.50–$1.60, and 23% tails each for below $1.45 or above $1.60.
Friday's U.S. jobs report, arriving before the October 5 resolution, adds macroeconomic uncertainty to the outcome.

items.title: BMTV: Macro, Wall Street, and Bitcoin
points: Bitcoin Magazine's BMTV segment analyzes macroeconomic trends and Wall Street institutional adoption signals and their impact on Bitcoin price direction.
Hosts Grace Remington and Sean Hagan discuss how traditional finance institutions are positioning themselves in crypto markets.
